jellyfin-android.description:
Jellyfin is the official free and open-source Android client for Jellyfin, the privacy-focused media server that puts you in control of your personal entertainment library.

Stream movies, TV shows, music, and other media directly from your self-hosted Jellyfin server to your Android device. Browse your libraries, explore media details, and enjoy your personal collection through an intuitive interface.

Features include video and audio streaming, library browsing, playback controls, support for Live TV and recorded programs, and Chromecast streaming with the compatible app variant.

Jellyfin is completely free, with no subscription fees, advertisements, or tracking. Your media remains under your control, making it an excellent choice for home media servers and self-hosted entertainment.

A running Jellyfin server is required to use the app.
